name: ${idmc.project} - 5 Reset
status: PROVEN (2026-10-13, same shape); toolkit/mapgen build ADAPTED (compiles offline; not yet imported in this form)
description: RESET, 3 steps: the task's pre-processing command attaches each agency's original again as a NEW version of the same CRM file wherever the newest differs (nothing deleted; CDI rejects a ContentVersion new-version insert, L-CONN-115) -> the mapping logs which documents were reset.

nodes.name: SRC_ORIGINALS
nodes.query: SELECT O.CONTENT_DOCUMENT_ID AS DOC, O.TITLE AS TITLE, L.VERSION_NUMBER AS LATEST FROM (SELECT * FROM ${snowflake.database}.${snowflake.schema}.BID_BRZ_SF_DOCUMENT QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONTENT_DOCUMENT_ID ORDER BY TRY_TO_NUMBER(VERSION_NUMBER), LOADED_AT) = 1) O JOIN (SELECT * FROM ${snowflake.database}.${snowflake.schema}.BID_BRZ_SF_DOCUMENT QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONTENT_DOCUMENT_ID ORDER BY TRY_TO_NUMBER(VERSION_NUMBER) DESC, LOADED_AT DESC) = 1) L ON L.CONTENT_DOCUMENT_ID = O.CONTENT_DOCUMENT_ID WHERE L.CHECKSUM <> O.CHECKSUM
